data.name: Kaisan
data.gender_notes: Kaisan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is free, independent, and pure in intention and action. A sovereign ruler. The name Kaisan carries the meaning “Free, Pure, Sovereign” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kaisan usually hope their child will grow to embody free, pure, sovereign and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who strive to be free from worldly desires and material possessions, and seek to rule their inner selves with wisdom and strength.
data.etymology: Kaisan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free, Pure, Sovereign.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaisan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: قيصان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من قيس، يعني الحجم أو المقدار
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قيصان مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ق-ي-س، والذي يعني الحجم أو المقدار، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية أن القيس هو التقدير والقياس، ومنه قوله تعالى: {وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ}، الآية 8 من سورة الرعد، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأحاديث النبوية

in_urdu.name: قیصان
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے اندازه یا پیمانہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: قیصان نام عربی زبان کے ق-ی-س جذر سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اندازه یا پیمانہ، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں استعمال ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ رعد میں: {وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ}، اور یہ نام بعض احادیث نبوی میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کا حجم یا مقدار

in_english.name: Kaisan
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root 'q-ys', meaning measure or quantity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kaisan originates from the Arabic root 'q-ys', which signifies measure or quantity. This root is mentioned in the Quran, such as in Surah Ar-Ra'd: {وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ}, and is also found in some Prophetic traditions. The name conveys the meaning of a thing's size or amount, symbolizing balance and proportion in Islamic context. It reflects the attribute of Allah as Al-Qadir, the All-Powerful, who measures and ordains everything

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kaisan" in Islamic culture is believed to convey the qualities of a free and independent spirit. It suggests an individual who is self-reliant, bold, and a confident leader. In history, there have been several prominent Islamic figures with this name, such as the medieval Islamic scholar Ibn Kaisan al-Balkhi, who was known for his philosophical and scientific contributions. This name can be seen as embodying the Islamic values of courage, independence, and intellectual pursuits.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Kaisan" holds deeper significance. It represents a person who is pure in intention and action, striving to live according to the guidance of the Almighty Allah. The name can be understood as a reminder to continually reflect on one's intentions and actions, ensuring they are in line with the divine will. In this way, bearing the name "Kaisan" is a constant reminder of the spiritual journey that each individual undertakes throughout their life. It is a name that inspires individuals to not only seek freedom and independence in their external lives but also strive for inner purity and closeness to Allah.
